products.name: Domestic RO Membranes
products.description: Domestic RO membranes support compact purification systems where reliable taste, clarity, and TDS reduction matter. They are selected for stable output in household and light-commercial applications.

products.name: RO Antiscalant
products.description: RO antiscalant helps control mineral scaling on membrane surfaces, supporting higher recovery and more stable differential pressure. Proper dosing is based on feed-water analysis and system design.

products.name: RO Controller and Instruments
products.description: RO controllers and instruments help teams monitor pressure, conductivity, flow, level, and protection interlocks. Good instrumentation improves operator confidence and makes troubleshooting faster.

products.name: Dosing Pumps
products.description: Dosing pumps meter treatment chemicals at controlled rates so plant operators can manage scale, pH, disinfection, and process conditioning. They help keep water-treatment performance predictable across changing feed conditions.

products.name: FRP Vessels
products.description: FRP vessels give filtration and softening systems a corrosion-resistant pressure body for media beds, distributors, and service valves. They are commonly used by OEMs and plant teams that need dependable performance with lower handling weight than metallic vessels.

products.name: Multiport Valves
products.description: Multiport valves simplify filter and softener operation by combining service, backwash, rinse, and regeneration paths in a compact control point. They help OEMs build cleaner assemblies with fewer external valves.

products.name: Distribution Systems
products.description: Distribution systems spread water evenly through the vessel, support media retention, and reduce channeling. Correct distributor selection protects media performance and keeps pressure drop under control.

products.name: Filter Cartridges
products.description: Filter cartridges remove suspended particles before sensitive equipment or at the final polishing stage. They are a practical safeguard for membranes, instruments, nozzles, and process lines.

products.name: Filter Media
products.description: Filter media supports removal of turbidity, color, odor, iron, organics, and application-specific contaminants. The right blend and bed depth help plants achieve consistent outlet quality.

products.name: Cation Exchange Resins
products.description: Cation exchange resins exchange hardness ions and support softening or demineralization processes. Resin selection influences exchange capacity, regeneration efficiency, and leakage control.

products.name: Electro Chlorination Systems
products.description: Electro chlorination systems generate disinfectant on site from salt, reducing dependency on bulk chemical handling. They are suited to facilities that need repeatable chlorination with safer logistics and better operational control.

products.name: High Pressure Pumps
products.description: High pressure pumps provide the pressure required for membrane separation and demanding water-transfer duties. Correct pump selection improves energy use, membrane performance, and operating stability.

products.name: Hydro Pneumatic Tanks
products.description: Hydro pneumatic tanks store pressurized water and reduce pump cycling in distribution systems. They support steady pressure for buildings, utilities, and packaged treatment plants.

products.name: Level Sensors
products.description: Level sensors protect pumps, automate tank operation, and improve visibility across water-handling systems. They help teams prevent dry run, overflow, and process interruption.

products.name: Wastewater Filtration Systems
products.description: Wastewater filtration systems help reduce suspended solids and improve water quality before discharge, reuse, or downstream treatment. They can be configured around application load and plant objectives.

products.name: Wastewater Dosing Systems
products.description: Wastewater dosing systems support pH control, coagulation, flocculation, odor management, and disinfection. Good dosing design improves treatment consistency and chemical control.

products.name: Wastewater Accessories
products.description: Wastewater accessories complete treatment installations with practical components for monitoring, handling, dosing, and maintenance. They help plants keep everyday operations cleaner and more controllable.
